description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the full content brainstorm workflow. (2) Identify that the output file must be named `weekly_content_plan.md`. (3) Apply the 3:3:1 topic ratio — exactly 3 trend-chasing topics, 3 evergreen topics, and 1 opinion/controversial topic — which is a proprietary constraint not guessable from general knowledge. (4) Generate the plan in the exact prescribed format: `## Weekly Content Plan ({date range})` header, `### Day N - {Weekday}` sections for all 7 days, each with `**Title:**`, `**Angle:**`, `**Keywords:**`, `**Virality:**` (using ⭐ scale with a text label like `⭐⭐⭐⭐ / High`), `**Reference:**`, and `**Est. time:**` fields. (5) Apply 小红书-native title formatting: emoji + numbers + keywords. (6) Separate each day with a `---` markdown horizontal rule. (7) Ensure all content is relevant to the zero-waste / eco-friendly niche on 小红书. The critical traps are the 3:3:1 ratio, the virality star+label format, and the platform-specific title style — none of which are guessable without reading the SKILL.md.
